attributes.title: NKF 2027 Spring Clinical Meetings
attributes.venue: Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort
attributes.summary:
Kidney care teams meet in Orlando on May 11 to 15, 2027. Pre-conference courses on May 11 cover transplantation, home dialysis, critical care, stones and inpatient nephrology, so choose the day before booking flights. General sessions follow on May 12 to 15.

The listed fees are physician rates: $550 for members and $950 for nonmembers through March 10, 2027, then $625 and $1,000. Member rates for APPs and nurses are $425 and $475; for residents, $125 and $150. Nonmember rates in those groups are higher. The in-person and on-demand prices match.

NKF runs a continuing education program and credit can be claimed from May 15 to June 28, 2027. Physician credit types and totals are not published yet on the pages we checked.
